title: SPP Confident of Compliance with FERC Show Cause

meta.summary:
SPP says it is 90% compliant with FERC’s show-cause order on large load interconnection processes, pointing to its development of a new participation model for flexible price-sensitive loads as a major reason why. 
 The post  SPP Confident of Compliance with FERC Show Cause  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
